newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on CBOT, commercial selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on CBOT, commercial selling.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on lower CBOT soycomplex values and commercial and local selling.

"We were down on Chicago, there were light hedges, Cargill sold 300 July late and sold hedges in September and November," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin fell to -9.55 Monday from -3.96 Friday. About 50 July-Aug spread at $0.50, 300 July-Nov $34. Volume was 3,595 lots, or 71,900 tonnes, with 85 hedge lots.
July canola lost $2.80 to $400.20, November down $2.10 to $367.60. July flax fell $2 to set a new low of $328.50 on hedges, November down $1.30 to a new low of $314. Volume 135.
Alberta Wheat Pool sold July western barley down $1.10 to $131.50, October down $0.50 to $133.40 as commission houses bought shorts, traders said. July-Oct $2. Oats did not trade.
July wheat lost $1.90 at $156.60 on late hedges, October fell $1.10 at $159 as RBC-DS bought from PCTS. Alberta Wheat Pool sold 25 July-Oct at $1.50, 75 Dec-Mar $3, July-Dec $2.
LFG bought 15 October feed pea contracts down US$0.90 to US$183.50 from a commercial, a trader said.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
